notes.content: Hello everyone, I recently adjusted the game values, and the difficulty is more challenging than the previous version. I hope to enhance your experience with the hero system. notes.title: Hero System Rebuild
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for playing PlatinumS!

Recently, based on the feedback I received, it showed that the hero units were too easy to die and difficult to upgrade, so I reworked the hero system in the past two days.

The shop can now sell an unlimited number of hero units (just need enough money).
After purchasing a hero, you can upgrade the hero directly in the queue settings interface, so that you can bring high-level hero units into the level from the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815839/1ef6706e1e7ffd25f0acfc072275f8aa7a4edf07.jpg[/img]

In addition, the first-level hero can now not only be used to upgrade, but also to restore health, greatly enhancing the survivability of the hero.

In addition to the above main contents, this update also includes some other issues:
1. The purchase interface can now more clearly show the remaining coins and purchase amount
2. The attendant information in the menu now displays the corresponding level information
3. Weapons are now unlocked according to the stage unlocking progress to improve the balance of difficulty
4. Reduced the strength of rotating stick weapons
5. Adjusted Ema's unlocking stage to stage one
6. Adjusted Melody's unlocking stage to stage two

The above is the main content of this update. I wish you all have fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
This modification is mainly to fix the bugs and adjust the game difficulty. The updates are as follows:
Fixed issues:
1. Fixed the problem of enemies not spawning in the middle of the level
2. Fixed the problem of the ultimate trial not being unlocked
3. Fixed the problem of Muller not attacking
4. Fixed the problem of heroes in the chest not being successfully unlocked
5. Fixed the problem of the hero attack explosion range being too large
Difficulty adjustment:
1. Increase the basic health and defense value of all heroes
2. Reduce the health of some enemies
3. Reduce the charge time of the impact enemy
4. Reduce the number of refreshes of long-range enemies

notes.title: Game remake and new demo release
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your interest in this game

Since the release of the first demo, we have noticed that there are still many problems with our game design, so after discussion and review, we have decided to remake our game.

Recently, the remake of our game has been largely completed, and uploaded a new version of the demo, I hope you like it!

We've reworked the demo's store page to make it easier for you to review your experience. If you have other comments and opinions about the game, welcome to leave us a message, thank you!

The following are the main contents of the new version:

1. You can play as a Lord among four lords, and each Lord provides a bonus for different attack types of heroes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815839/54ae273dc11dd10d9eb59a07b933d03f80480ef5.png[/img]
2. You can buy weapons and accessories in the store to increase the strength of the Lord

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815839/ce059b0026ffbbfcf25779a2973be1afb9ee1aa8.png[/img]
3. Heroes can be purchased or replenished when level up

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815839/b5dbb514fa73380d1d2dfc45dc052f7d065c118e.jpg[/img]
4. Upgrade optional secondary weapons and add squad attack mode

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815839/52d40310c4406501f3bfb24ab458c4cdf3cd8b8b.png[/img]
Have fun!

3. Heroes can be purchased or replenished when level up
4. Upgrade optional secondary weapons and add squad attack mode

notes.title: PlatinumS Demo patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Everyone,
[/b][/h2]

Hope you are great!

We have gathered valuable feedback from our players, and recognizing that there is still significant room for improvement, we have conducted a thorough analysis of this input. As a result, we have decided to implement substantial changes to enhance the game. Our focus is on maintaining the stability of the demo while incorporating these improvements.

Here is patch for Demo 0.2.1

[h2][b]Patch notes for 0.2.1[/b][/h2]

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*]Added chest that enables players to purchase additional heroes even when the queue is already full.
[*]Extension of the time available for players to collect coins after each wave concludes. However, it's important to note that any unclaimed coins will be automatically removed once the wave ends.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed paid heroes not shown in shop screen
[*] Fixed bullets disappear when Arol's unit time out
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] All heroes HP +5
[*] Damage Oakley	3 -> 4
[*] Damage Lee	4 -> 5
[*] Damage Arol	3 -> 4
[*] Damage Lester	3 -> 4
[*] Damage Ema	3 -> 4
[*] Damage Fisher	3 -> 5
[*] Damage Dayton	3 -> 5
[*] Damage Cube 	3 -> 5
[*] Damage Arthur	4 -> 5
[/list]
